lets make the slot machine more eductional and more fun 
while we do want to keep only fifty rolling on the server 
lets also keep another list of fifty winners at the bottom as well 
so up to fifty winners at the bottom 
and for each result that is a winner 
the box should be expandable 
and it should give you all kinds of details about 
what the odds of this kind of a result was 
and teach a little bit about probability as well 
try to include good concise factual information 
we won't show it by default only when someone clicks it or taps on the particular winning result 

Use your best judgment

if there are a lot of files that need to change

    Whole project as one tar.gz, unambiguous file placement
    Any files to delete on updates called out explicitly
    No bespoke sed/patch scripts — full files only for anything that changes

Ran 34 commands, read memory, and 2 more tools
Working out how concurrent database version upgrades are handled.
Working out how CSS scoping affects the loading spinner styles.
Checking the sandbox environment for available tools.
Working out where to place a Razor component.
Calculating the average number of spins expected.
Debugging the order of empty-state update calls.
Fixing a global-variable scoping issue in the edit script.
Checking which code analysis rules apply to the project.
Adding tests for choice and outcome logic.
Updating slot service tests for the winners window logic.
Working out how to generate a time-based identifier.
Checking indentation rules for a raw string literal.
Checking configuration files for slot-related settings.
Determining the correct type for a null-coalescing expression.
Presented file
The whole project is in chaos-velixir-run.tar.gz, built from main at dbbb73a9e4. It unpacks to chaos-velixir-run/. No files need deleting.

What changed

Server winners list: The server now keeps a second list of the newest 50 winners (SlotWinnerCapacity, default 50). The rolling 50 results work as before.
Snapshots and deltas now include winnersAdded and winnersRemoved.
After a restart, browsers send their 50 newest local winners back through a new OfferWinners call. This finds winners in the existing spins store, so the IndexedDB schema is unchanged.
Page: A “Winners” section now sits below the results. A winner from a spin only appears there once its reels stop.
Odds panel: Every winner, in either list, can be tapped open; it’s closed by default. The panel is built in the browser the first time it’s opened, from lesson() in SlotIsland.razor.js, which is the only place this text lives. It shows:
how many results are this kind of win, out of 36⁵ = 60,466,176
the chance per spin
the average wait, as spins and as time spinning nonstop at the server’s spin time
the median wait
the equivalent run of coin flips all coming up heads
this kind’s share of all wins
for three of a kind with a pair, the extra odds of that
how the count is worked out, one probability idea per kind (multiplication rule, counting, “5 choose 3” and the birthday problem, order versus choice), and short notes that every exact string is equally likely, that nothing is ever “due”, and the overall chance of any win.
A surprise worth knowing: Straights (753,984 ways in both directions) are more common than three or more of a kind (447,336).
Tests: The JS tests check the formulas against a search of every result over a six-symbol alphabet. There are new xUnit tests for the winners list and the options check, an HTTP test that the page renders winners, and a Playwright test that seeds a local winner, opens it, and checks for “1 in 9,598”.
Docs: ADR 0019, the README and the About page are updated.
What I could verify

The JS tests all pass here (97).
I ran the island in a simulated browser: snapshot, spin, winner held back until the reels stop, the panel opening, and both kinds of offers.
I couldn’t build or run the .NET side here, because there’s no .NET SDK in this sandbox. The C# changes compile only in my head, so far.
One construct to watch in run-all.sh: SlotResult.razor uses the RenderFragment Row => __builder => { … } markup pattern.

Resolving a visibility mismatch between components and messages.
Resolving a visibility mismatch between components and messages.
The cause: BoardMessage is internal, and Razor components are generated as public classes, so a public [Parameter] can’t be of that type. The fix is to pass the result’s Id and Text as plain parameters instead, which keeps BoardMessage internal. Two files change.

src/Chaos.Web/Components/Pages/SlotResult.razor

razor
<li class="@Classes" data-id="@Id">
    @if (_win is SlotWin.None)
    {
        @Row
    }
    else
    {
        <details class="odds" data-text="@Text">
            <summary class="row">@Row</summary>
        </details>
    }
</li>

@code {
    private SlotWin _win;
    private bool[] _hits = [];

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public Guid Id { get; set; }

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public string Text { get; set; } = "";

    [Parameter]
    public DateTimeOffset Now { get; set; }

    private string Classes => _win is SlotWin.None ? "msg" : "msg win";

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        _win = SlotRules.Classify(Text);
        _hits = SlotRules.Hits(Text);
    }

    private RenderFragment Row => __builder =>
    {
        <time datetime="@MessageFormat.Iso(Id)">@MessageFormat.Label(Id, Now)</time>
        <p class="symbols">
            @for (var i = 0; i < Text.Length; i++)
            {
                <span class="@(_hits[i] ? "hit" : null)">@Text[i]</span>
            }
        </p>
        @if (_win is not SlotWin.None)
        {
            <p class="tags"><strong class="badge">@SlotRules.Label(_win)</strong><span class="more">Odds</span></p>
        }
    };
}
src/Chaos.Web/Components/Pages/SlotsPage.razor

razor
@page "/slots"
@inject SlotService Slots
@inject TimeProvider Time

<PageTitle>Chaos slots</PageTitle>

<h1>Slots</h1>
<p class="lede">One shared machine and one big button. Whoever presses first spins for everyone, and nobody can press again until the reels stop. Three or more of a kind, or five in a row up or down, is a winner. Tap a winner to see how rare it was and why. Nothing is at stake.</p>

<SlotIsland Client="@_client" Face="@_face" @rendermode="InteractiveServer" />

<section class="feed" data-permanent="slots-feed" aria-labelledby="spins-title">
    <h2 id="spins-title">Results</h2>
    <p id="slots-empty" class="empty" hidden="@(_results.Count > 0)">No spins yet. Press the button.</p>
    <ol id="slots-feed" class="spins">
        @foreach (var result in _results)
        {
            <SlotResult @key="result.Id" Id="result.Id" Text="@result.Text" Now="_now" />
        }
    </ol>
    <button type="button" id="slots-older" class="older" hidden>Show older results</button>
</section>

<section class="feed" data-permanent="slots-winners-feed" aria-labelledby="winners-title">
    <h2 id="winners-title">Winners</h2>
    <p class="note">The newest @Slots.WinnerCapacity winning spins, kept after they leave the results.</p>
    <p id="slots-winners-empty" class="empty" hidden="@(_winners.Count > 0)">No winners yet.</p>
    <ol id="slots-winners" class="spins">
        @foreach (var result in _winners)
        {
            <SlotResult @key="result.Id" Id="result.Id" Text="@result.Text" Now="_now" />
        }
    </ol>
</section>

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> _results = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<BoardMessage> _winners = [];
    private DateTimeOffset _now;
    private string _client = ClientAddress.Unknown;
    private string? _face;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext? HttpContext { get; set; }

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        var spinning = Slots.Spinning?.Id;
        _results = [.. Slots.Messages.Where(result => result.Id != spinning)];
        _winners = [.. Slots.Winners.Where(result => result.Id != spinning)];
        _face = _results.Count > 0 ? _results[0].Text : null;
        _now = Time.GetUtcNow();
        _client = ClientAddress.Key(HttpContext?.Connection.RemoteIpAddress);
    }
}
No other files are affected and none need deleting. I still can’t compile here, so if the build stops on anything else, send the next error.
